_readme: TME_Templates_MarketPulseRates_v1.json — deploy to Netlify as rates.json (site root, beside index.html). Fill from Mortgage News Daily each business morning after ~9:30 AM CT. Leave a value null to render 'Data Pending' — never estimate. rate = percent (6.12), change = day-over-day in percentage points (+0.03 / -0.05 / 0). Ops: TME_Spec_MarketPulseDashboard_Ops_*
